description: Request limits on /sync and /v1: a path and query over 8192 bytes gets a 414, a Cookie header over 16384 bytes a 431, with no cookies; opt-out is never refused for size. The 431 case checks only the status and cookies: servers whose own header limit is lower (Node.js allows 16 KB for all headers) refuse it first with their own response. Not run against live deployments (live: false): a CDN in front applies its own limits first (CloudFront answers the long URLs, opt-out included, with its own 414 and the large Cookie header with a 400).

cases.name: refuses a /sync path and query over 8192 bytes with a 414 and no cookies, before reading the id
refuses a /v1 path and query over 8192 bytes with a 414 and no cookies
answers a /sync path and query of exactly 8192 bytes
refuses a /v1 Cookie header over 16384 bytes with a 431 and no cookies
